request.objective: Establish acquisition-v2 as a provider-neutral managed acquisition seam while preserving the integrated ledger, search, qualification, evidence, no-repeat, and telemetry behavior.

architecture_seam.provider_contract: ProviderAdapter.fetch(SearchTask) -> ProviderBatch; AcquisitionRecord keeps provider identity separate from source_surface and carries URL roles, query/task key, provider record ID, observation timestamp, card/detail, and raw provider metadata.
architecture_seam.shared_ingestion: Browser RPC and acquisition-v2 call shared persist_card and persist_detail services, which retain existing discovery persistence, canonical ledger upsert/versioning, scoring, evidence readiness, URL-role handling, counters, and reconciliation.
architecture_seam.coordinator_cli: python -m jobbot acquire --provider jsonl-file|json-file --path ...; managed-http transport is injectable for callers/tests and the R1 CLI makes no live HTTP call.
architecture_seam.completion_and_failure: A task exhausts only when the provider returns COMPLETE with non-empty explicit completion evidence. Missing proof, partial batches, ambiguous cursors, transport errors, timeouts, invalid responses, and detail failures remain incomplete or retryable. Previously committed sightings are retained. Managed-provider failure never falls back to legacy Chrome.
architecture_seam.provider_claims: Provider payloads are observations. Ingestion ignores provider-supplied verification upgrades; source and application destinations remain governed by existing evidence verification.

migration.name: CHG-200 provider-neutral acquisition provenance
migration.backfill: Historical rows are deterministically labeled legacy-browser/unknown, with task key and phase copied where available; job truth and evidence states are unchanged.

architecture_seam.canonicalization: Explicit ATS/employer requisition URL roles participate in existing reconciliation; distinct explicit requisition URLs stay distinct when exact text otherwise matches.
architecture_seam.provider_selection: RUN_NOW remains unchanged in R1. Managed-provider production qualification and selection are pending. The normal-Chrome Big-3 runner is documented as frozen legacy/deprecated; direct ATS retrieval remains independent verification/enrichment.

equivalence_and_failure_coverage: Equivalent card/detail input through legacy browser RPC and acquisition-v2 shared ingestion yields the same canonical job, source occurrence, snapshot/version behavior, evidence readiness, qualification result, and recommendation.
JSONL card/detail ingestion persists identity before detail and does not create an extra job version.
Missing description/location/salary/application data remains incomplete, REVIEW/UNKNOWN, and non-actionable.
The same requisition observed through two providers reconciles to one canonical job while provider sightings remain in durable task results; distinct ATS requisitions stay distinct.
Timeout/error after committed sightings preserves those rows and leaves the task incomplete/retryable.
Explicit completion evidence closes a task; absent proof does not.
Provider provenance appears in dashboard, exports, and CHG-114 provider diagnostics without changing existing task/family ordering samples or minimum-sample guardrails.

validation.execution_boundary: Tests ran in a disposable copy of the working tree with its data directory excluded. No live Chrome or Big-3 runtime was used.
